hook: Chess legends don't usually lose by spending 26 minutes on one move.

sections.voiceover: Chess legends don't usually lose by spending 26 minutes on one move.
At the November 2026 London Chess Classic, Vasyl Ivanchuk faced Gawain Jones in round 2. Why did Ivanchuk burn 26 minutes on move 10?
That King's Indian Defense move 10 forced the 2635-rated Ivanchuk into a deep, time-consuming calculation.
Jones exploited the clock pressure to force a win in 35 moves against the Ukrainian legend. Gawain Jones secured the victory after the 2635-rated Ivanchuk failed to recover from his time trouble.
That 26-minute think time shifted the London Chess Classic standings.
